subject: gk
question: Pancha Mahal is located in which of these cities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fatehpur Sikri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Pancha Mahal is a historical structure located in **Fatehpur Sikri**.
 
• Fatehpur Sikri was established by the Mughal Emperor **Akbar** in the late 16th century.
 
• Pancha Mahal is known for its **five-storied structure** with diminishing sizes of floors.
 
• The architectural design of Pancha Mahal exhibits a mix of **Persian and Indian styles**.
 
• It was primarily used as a **pleasure pavilion** by the royal family.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fatehpur Sikri**

 
 
• It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a fine example of Mughal architecture.
 
• Fatehpur Sikri served as the capital of the Mughal Empire for a brief period.
 
• Key structures in Fatehpur Sikri include Buland Darwaza, Jama Masjid, and the Tomb of Salim Chishti.
 
 
 
• **Jaipur**
 
 
• Known as the Pink City, Jaipur is famous for its palaces and forts like Hawa Mahal, Amber Fort, and City Palace.
 
• Jaipur is the capital city of the Indian state of Rajasthan.
 
 
 
• **Delhi**
 
 
• Delhi, the capital of India, is rich in history and houses monuments like the Red Fort, Qutub Minar, and India Gate.
 
• It is a major political, cultural, and commercial center in India.
